verdict.rationale: Fellow's webhooks send real-time HTTP POST notifications when events occur, such as an AI note being generated or an action item being completed. Its REST API can then act on notes and action items, for example appending to an agenda or marking an item complete. Together these let a user build event-driven automations, but only with their own external receiver or glue code; there is no evidence of an in-product rule builder. Missing for 10: a native rule/automation builder with conditions and actions, documented webhook event catalog and filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
